mds components

mds:calendar

A Jalali date-picker grid — an open version of a Flux Pro component, on the Iranian calendar.

Flux's calendar is Gregorian. This one is Jalali by default — Farvardin to Esfand, the week opening on Saturday, leap years from MajidDs\Support\Jalali — and it hands your Livewire property an ISO Gregorian Y-m-d string all the same. Click around: the grid is live.

Shahrivar 1405
SSaturday SSunday MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday 
<mds:calendar wire:model="deliverAt" />
What the grid draws and what the model stores are two different things. The visible month is Jalali; the hidden input holds 2026-08-24, so Carbon, your database and every validation rule see an ordinary date.

Selecting

Bind it with wire:model, or give it a name and post the form the plain way. value seeds the selection and picks the month the calendar opens on.

Mordad 1405
SSaturday SSunday MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday 
<mds:calendar name="deliver_at" value="2026-08-20" />

Ranges

The first click opens the span and the second closes it, in either order; the pointer previews it in between. The two ends bind to dotted paths under your property — wire:model="trip" fills trip.start and trip.end.

Mordad 1405
SSaturday SSunday MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday 
<mds:calendar mode="range" wire:model="trip" :value="['2026-08-20', '2026-08-26']" />

Several days

mode="multiple" toggles days on and off. Livewire receives a sorted array of ISO dates, through a visually hidden <select multiple>.

Mordad 1405
SSaturday SSunday MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday 
<mds:calendar mode="multiple" wire:model="days" :value="['2026-08-20', '2026-08-25', '2026-08-26']" />

Bounds and days off

min and max close the ends — and the month arrows with them. unavailable takes out individual days inside the range: a holiday, a full delivery slot, a booked room.

Shahrivar 1405
SSaturday SSunday MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday 
<mds:calendar min="2026-08-16" max="2026-09-12" :unavailable="['2026-08-28', '2026-09-04']" value="2026-08-24" />
Blocked days keep their place in the grid and stay reachable by keyboard — they carry aria-disabled, not the disabled attribute, so a screen reader can still read out why a week looks empty.

Several months

months draws up to twelve grids side by side — the usual shape for choosing a stay. fixed-weeks pads every month to six rows so the box stops changing height as you page through.

Shahrivar 1405 – Mehr 1405
Shahrivar 1405
SSaturday SSunday MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday
Mehr 1405
SSaturday SSunday MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday 
<mds:calendar mode="range" :months="2" fixed-weeks :value="['2026-08-26', '2026-09-08']" />

Week numbers

A row-header column, counting from the week that holds the 1st of the calendar's own year — Farvardin 1 here, January 1 for a Gregorian grid — so the number means the same thing whichever system and start-day you chose.

Shahrivar 1405
#Week SSaturday SSunday MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday
23
24
25
26
27 
<mds:calendar week-numbers value="2026-08-24" />

Header and today

selectable-header swaps the month title for two selects, which is how you get from here to a birthday in 1372 without three hundred clicks. with-today adds a shortcut under the grid; in single mode it selects today as well as scrolling to it.

Shahrivar 1405
SSaturday SSunday MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday 
<mds:calendar selectable-header with-today />

Sizes

Three cell sizes. sm fits a calendar into a popover or a sidebar; lg is the one to use on a touch screen.

Shahrivar 1405
SSaturday SSunday MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday
Shahrivar 1405
SSaturday SSunday MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday
Shahrivar 1405
SSaturday SSunday MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday 
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-6">
    <mds:calendar size="sm" value="2026-08-24" />
    <mds:calendar value="2026-08-24" />
    <mds:calendar size="lg" value="2026-08-24" />
</div>

Read-only

A static calendar shows a date instead of asking for one — an order timeline, a booking confirmation. It reports aria-readonly and ignores clicks; the arrows still work, so the month around the date can be read.

Mordad 1405
SSaturday SSunday MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday 
<mds:calendar static :value="['2026-08-20', '2026-08-24']" mode="range" />

The Gregorian grid

Same component, other calendar. calendar="gregorian" opens the week on Monday and names the months in the ISO way; start-day overrides the first column in either system (0 is Sunday, 6 is Saturday).

August 2026
MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday SSaturday SSunday
August 2026
SSunday MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday SSaturday 
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-6">
    <mds:calendar calendar="gregorian" value="2026-08-24" />
    <mds:calendar calendar="gregorian" :start-day="0" value="2026-08-24" />
</div>

Validation

An explicit error wins; without one the message comes from the error bag for name. Either way the border reddens, the root gets data-invalid, and the grid points at the message with aria-describedby.

Shahrivar 1405
SSaturday SSunday MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday
Pick a delivery day.
Shahrivar 1405
SSaturday SSunday MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday 
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-6">
    <mds:calendar name="deliver_at" error="Pick a delivery day." />
    <mds:calendar invalid value="2026-08-24" />
</div>

Keyboard

The grid follows the WAI-ARIA pattern: one cell is in the tab order, then the arrows take over. Focus the calendar above and try it — ← → move a day the way the arrow points (the page direction is read at the keypress, so this works the same on an RTL page), ↑ ↓ move a week, Home and End jump to the ends of the week, PageUp / PageDown move a month and hold Shift for a year.

Mordad 1405
#Week SSaturday SSunday MMonday TTuesday WWednesday TThursday FFriday
18
19
20
21
22
23 
<mds:calendar value="2026-08-20" week-numbers with-today />

Persian output

config('mds.persian_digits') — on by default in a real app, off in these docs — switches the digits, the month and weekday names and every built-in string to Persian; :fa="true" does it for one calendar. The calendar system does not move with it: this is the same Jalali grid as everywhere above, and calendar="gregorian" with :fa="true" would give you a Persian-language Gregorian one.

مرداد ۱۴۰۵
#هفته ششنبه ییکشنبه ددوشنبه سسه‌شنبه چچهارشنبه پپنجشنبه ججمعه
۱۸
۱۹
۲۰
۲۱
۲۲
۲۳
مرداد ۱۴۰۵
ششنبه ییکشنبه ددوشنبه سسه‌شنبه چچهارشنبه پپنجشنبه ججمعه 
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-6">
    <mds:calendar :fa="true" wire:model="deliverAt" value="2026-08-20" week-numbers with-today label="روز تحویل" />
    <mds:calendar :fa="true" mode="range" :value="['2026-08-20', '2026-08-26']" size="sm" />
</div>
The visible digits are Persian; the hidden input still holds 2026-08-20. Machine values never change language.

Reference

mds:calendar

PropDescription
valueThe selection. A date string or object; an array for multiple, and [start, end] or ['start' => …, 'end' => …] for range. Also picks the month the calendar opens on.
modesingle (default), multiple or range.
minEarliest selectable date. Also stops the back arrow.
maxLatest selectable date. Also stops the forward arrow.
unavailableArray of individual dates to disable inside the bounds.
monthsHow many months to show side by side, 1 to 12. Default: 1.
calendarjalali (default) or gregorian.
start-dayFirst column of the week, 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday). Defaults to Saturday for Jalali, Monday for Gregorian.
week-numbersAdds a week-number column. Default: false.
fixed-weeksAlways draws six rows, so the height never changes. Default: false.
selectable-headerMonth and year selects instead of the title. Default: false.
with-todayA "today" shortcut under the grid. Default: false.
staticRead-only: no picking, no hover preview. Default: false.
sizeCell size: sm, lg, or the default.
nameField name for a plain form post, and the key the error bag is read with.
labelAccessible name for the grid. Default: Calendar, or «تقویم» with Persian output.
invalidApplies error styling.
errorValidation message. Falls back to the bag for name.
faPersian digits and Persian built-in strings. Default: config('mds.persian_digits').
wire:modelBinds to a Livewire property — the hidden input, the hidden multiple select, or x.start / x.end in range mode.
